subject.title: fix(feishu): WebSocket encryptKey SecretRefs are ignored at runtime

question: Should Feishu WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRefs become active for existing explicit configs, even when a stale ref now fails resolution instead of being ignored?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and correct, but it changes upgrade behavior for an existing config secret field, which ClawSweeper should not accept silently on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Accept explicit SecretRef activation
options.body: Merge this PR with the intended behavior that any explicitly configured Feishu WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRef is an active runtime secret.

options.title: Preserve upgrade leniency
options.body: Ask for a compatibility path or maintainer note if existing stale WebSocket `encryptKey` refs must continue to be ignored during upgrade.

options.title: Pause for Feishu owner input
options.body: Hold the PR until a Feishu/runtime-secret owner confirms whether optional WebSocket encryption keys should fail closed when configured.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit SecretRef activation
recommendation.body: Merge this PR with the intended behavior that any explicitly configured Feishu WebSocket `encryptKey` SecretRef is an active runtime secret.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the Feishu account resolver and secret-contract paths being changed.
